text: Before Monday evening: Simpson comes down to Dartmoor
why: Simpson says he came down to Dartmoor for information and was already there by the Monday evening visit, living in one of the villas.

text: How did Straker's overcoat come to the furze-bush? — blown off by the storm
why: The coat was found flapping on a furze-bush on a night of rain and storm, so a reader could fairly wonder whether the wind blew it there.

text: What made the blow to Straker's head? — Simpson's Penang-lawyer
why: The story says the lead-weighted Penang-lawyer was just such a weapon as could have caused the head injuries.

text: How did the cravat come into Straker's hand?
why: Simpson cannot account for the cravat being in the dead man's hand, so the question is open.

text: How did the cravat come into Straker's hand? — torn from the stranger in the struggle
id: q.cravat_how=torn from the stranger in the struggle
why: Straker is said to have defended himself vigorously, which makes this an obvious possibility.

text: How did the cravat come into Straker's hand? — lost by the stranger, picked up by Straker
id: q.cravat_how=lost by the stranger, picked up by Straker
why: Simpson's inability to explain the cravat gives a reader reason to consider that he lost it and Straker picked it up.
